description: This file defines a React functional component called TrackingDashboard, which provides a package tracking user interface. It includes input handling, animations, and mock data to simulate tracking information. The component uses React hooks, framer-motion for animations, animejs for progress bar animations, and lucide-react icons.

methods.name: TrackingDashboard
methods.description: React functional component for the tracking dashboard UI, handling user input, mock data display, and animations.
